Provided that their seniority vis-à-vis the employees of the Exploration 
Promotion Division of the Directorate General of Mines and Minerals of the 
Department shall be determined with reference to regular and continuous date of 
appointment of both the employees to the respective cadre/post.
(2) The inter-se-seniority of the employees on their absorption shall 
remain the same as they enjoyed during their employment under SDA.
(3) The terms and conditions of service of the employees shall be the 
same as admissible to the civil servants; provided that such terms and conditions
shall not be less favorable than those admissible to them under SDA. 
6. Indemnity.---No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against 
Government or any other person for anything in good faith done or intended to be 
done under this Act or any rule or order made thereunder.
7. Removal of difficulties.---For the purpose of carrying into effect the 
provisions of this Act, Government shall provide for-
(a) the removal of difficulties, if any, arising out of, or in 
connection with, the transfer to, and absorption of, the 
employees as aforesaid; and
(b) other matters supplemental or incidental to, or consequential 
upon, such transfer and absorption.
8. Provision to over-ride other laws.---The provisions of this Act and the rules 
and orders made thereunder shall have effect notwithstanding anything to the 
contrary contained any other law for the time being in force.
9. Power to make rules.---Government may make rules for carrying out the 
purposes of this Act.
10. Repeal.---The North-West Frontier Province Sarhad Development Authority 
Mineral Wing (Taking-Over) Ordinance, 2008 (N.-W.F.P. Ordinance No. XIX of 
2008) is hereby repealed.
